## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Parikkhārahāravibhaṅga* ("Conveying Requisites: Analysis") is an analytical section of the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Ne 18) [SuttaCentral]. Bimala Charan Law characterizes the *Parikkhārahāra* of the *Netti* as a chapter based upon the *Paṭṭhāna*, which elucidates causal correlation while contributing to the systematic analytical exposition of teachings traditionally attributed to Mahākaccāyana [Law 1923].
No curated cross-language parallels are cataloged by SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral]. Automatically computed text-reuse analysis via DharmaNexus indicates extensive internal links across the Pali canon and exegetical literature: it shares substantial material with the *Netti* commentaries (*Nettivibhāvinī* and the *Nettippakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā*), parallel methodological treatments in the *Peṭakopadesa* (Pe 5 and Pe 8), doctrinal analyses in the *Vibhaṅga* (Vb 6) and *Kathāvatthu* (Kv 2.2), as well as suttas from the *Nidāna Saṁyutta* (SN 12) and *Saḷāyatana Saṁyutta* (SN 35) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns segments of the text with Sanskrit and Tibetan works, including Śāntideva's *Śikṣāsamuccaya*, the *Arthaviniścayasūtra*, the *Bodhisattvapiṭakasūtra*, and the *Śālistambasūtra* [DharmaNexus].
